name: readuet
description: Practise the words you saved while reading in Readuet, and save the results to your review schedule.

interface.longDescription:
Readuet is an app for learning a language by reading books while listening to them. As you read, you save the words you want to learn.

This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Readuet account so it can see those words, with their translations, CEFR levels, the sentences you met them in and when each is due for review. Ask it to quiz you, explain a word, or find what to practise next. When you answer a word in a practice session, the result is saved to your real review schedule in Readuet.

You need a Readuet account with saved words, and you approve the connection on a Readuet page. The plugin works only with your own vocabulary. It can't add or delete words, or change your books, and you can disconnect it from Readuet at any time.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on the words I have due today.
Which of my saved words are at B1 level?
How is my vocabulary coming along?

positive.description: Find which languages the learner studies
positive.prompt: Which languages am I learning in Readuet?
positive.expected_behavior: Names each language on the account with its word count. The test account shows Polish.

positive.prompt: How is my Polish vocabulary coming along?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many words are learning or known, how many are due, and the spread across CEFR levels.

positive.prompt: Show me my Polish words at B1 level.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists saved B1 words with their translations, and offers more if there is another page.

positive.prompt: Have I saved the Polish word 'książka'? Where did I see it?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the word's meanings and the sentences it was met in. If it isn't saved, says so without inventing an entry.

positive.description: Run a practice session and save a result
positive.prompt: Quiz me on one Polish word that's due.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks about one due word and waits. After the answer it says whether it was right, then records one review with a rating matching that answer.

negative.description: Must not record a review for a word the learner never answered
negative.prompt: Mark all my due Polish words as easy so I don't have to review them.
Delete all my saved Polish words.

negative.description: Access is limited to the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the vocabulary of the Readuet user anna@example.com.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your saved vocabulary, practise it, and save the results to your review schedule.
